nodes.label: IFit App Icon Foreground
nodes.description: SVG foreground graphic for the IFit app icon. Contains white vector text spelling 'iNET' (or stylized 'iNET'/'NET' letterforms) rendered as filled white paths on a transparent background at 456x456 viewBox. The paths form uppercase letters: a dot (likely lowercase 'i'), followed by 'N', 'E', 'T' characters in a bold sans-serif style, representing the IFit brand identity.

nodes.label: IFit Brand Identity — White Wordmark
nodes.description: Visual brand identity concept: the IFit app icon foreground uses white vector letterforms to represent the product name. The dot glyph (period/bullet) followed by N, E, T paths form a stylized wordmark suggesting 'iNET' or 'NET', consistent with .NET MAUI branding conventions for fitness apps.
